summary: In the temp pod, `cd /tmp/aap-temp-pvc`, check `sha256sum --check artifact.tar.sha256`, extract and check `sha256sum.txt`. Drop and recreate `automationcontroller` (`dropdb`, temporary `CREATEDB`, `createdb`, `NOCREATEDB`), then `pg_restore --clean --create --no-owner -h aap-postgres-15` the controller, hub and gateway dumps into `automationcontroller`, `automationhub` and `gateway`.
questions: How do I restore AAP databases on OpenShift?
Why drop the automationcontroller database before restore?

answer_card.title: Restore databases in the temp pod
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
cd /tmp/aap-temp-pvc
sha256sum --check artifact.tar.sha256
tar xf artifact.tar && cd artifact && sha256sum --check sha256sum.txt
dropdb -h aap-postgres-15 automationcontroller
#   ALTER USER automationcontroller WITH CREATEDB;
createdb -h aap-postgres-15 -U automationcontroller automationcontroller
#   ALTER USER automationcontroller NOCREATEDB;
pg_restore --clean --create --no-owner -h aap-postgres-15 -U automationcontroller -d automationcontroller controller/controller.pgc
pg_restore --clean --create --no-owner -h aap-postgres-15 -U automationhub -d automationhub hub/hub.pgc
pg_restore --clean --create --no-owner -h aap-postgres-15 -U gateway -d gateway gateway/gateway.pgc
```
